I have a problem with tests failing due to babel-jest 23 not transforming functions correctly, which is causing formatting issues. I need to take a closer look at the `formatFunction` source to figure out what's going wrong. Hmm, it’s probably related to how babel-jest processes or doesn’t process certain function formats. I’ll check the specifics and see if there’s a straightforward fix or if I have to adjust the setup in some way.
